milestonesForecast.name: Planning start - Rev0 complete; Rev1 schematic in review and layout underway
milestonesForecast.exitEvidence: Status supplied 2026-10-31. Historical completion dates and percent complete are unknown; this is a planning anchor, not the actual Rev0 completion date.

milestonesForecast.name: G0 - Requirements, test strategy and supplier assumptions accepted
milestonesForecast.exitEvidence: Requirements, launch markets, qualification plan, sample budget and accountable role assignments accepted. Named owners and capacity still to be assigned.

milestonesForecast.name: G1 - Release Rev1 PCBA prototype run
milestonesForecast.exitEvidence: Signed Rev1 build release; quote and proposed lot approved; Rev1 is an engineering prototype with fault-test restrictions documented.

milestonesForecast.name: G2 - Rev1 EVT findings and Rev2 change list approved
milestonesForecast.exitEvidence: Issue log contains root cause, severity, evidence and Rev2 disposition; power/RF/mechanical feasibility demonstrated. No automatic pass because boards powered up.

milestonesForecast.name: G3a - Cellular SIM and satellite launch decision
milestonesForecast.exitEvidence: Select provider/form factor and antenna/band plan. NTN either included with supported build/firmware/service and certification budget, or deferred with feature disabled and excluded from launch claims. Unresolved NTN requirement holds Rev2 freeze; no implicit terrestrial-only waiver.

milestonesForecast.name: G3 - Release Rev2 PCBA and housing tooling
milestonesForecast.exitEvidence: Controlled Rev2 electrical and mechanical release and PO approval. Freeze intended antennas, cables, resin, SIM/service scope and certification configuration. Long-lead commitments explicitly approved by operator.

milestonesForecast.name: G4 - T1 integrated evaluation and correction list accepted
milestonesForecast.exitEvidence: T1 loop target 6-8 weeks after freeze without supplier closure; baseline uses 20 + 5 supplier workdays, 5 calendar days transit and 5 engineering workdays evaluation. Electrical availability may drive later finish; holiday impact is explicit in supplier calendar.

milestonesForecast.name: G5 - T2 preproduction candidate accepted
milestonesForecast.exitEvidence: T2 loop target 4-6 weeks from correction release: 10 supplier workdays correction + 2 supplier workdays trial + 5 calendar days shipping + 10 engineering workdays evaluation. Candidate accepted for preproduction; Rev2/T1 formal campaigns are already running. T2 configuration and process changes enter explicit qualification delta review before market release.

milestonesForecast.name: G6 - Qualification and US/Canada release evidence accepted
milestonesForecast.exitEvidence: Signed qualification reports and required authorizations/acceptances cover the exact final T2 sale configuration. T2 delta disposition and affected retests closed, final labels/manuals approved, and NTN inclusion/deferment explicit before customer distribution. Earlier Rev2/T1 results are carried forward only with documented lab/quality agreement.

milestonesForecast.name: G7 - Controlled pilot build readiness
milestonesForecast.after: SOP MATERIAL FIXBUILD SWFACT SWPRODUCT MARKET
milestonesForecast.exitEvidence: Released exact hardware/firmware/BOM/work instructions, calibrated validated test stations, material, required compliance evidence and trained operators. Approve proposed PVT lot and quality targets before build.

milestonesForecast.name: G8 - Authorize mass production release
milestonesForecast.exitEvidence: Operator approves production quantity/PO against demand, cash, capacity and accepted quality. Qualified configuration and golden sample locked; change control, stop-ship and field monitoring owners assigned.

milestonesForecast.name: G9 - First mass-production lot ready to ship
milestonesForecast.exitEvidence: First MP lot accepted and released for shipment; subsequent ramp managed by yield, demand and field performance. Freight to customer is outside this ready-to-ship milestone.
